correctness.rationale: Lemmas 1-4 were checked deductively and all finite enumerations were independently replayed with alternate code paths. Lemma 1 (conjugation to Z0 fibre) holds by basis choice sending Z(L) to Z0; 2-step then forces image in Z0. Lemma 2 (dim Z = 2+dim Rad) holds because v+z is central iff v is killed by both alternating forms; Rad0 count 3360 was reproduced. Lemma 3 (isomorphism = GL(4,F2)xGL(2,F2) action, |Aut|=256*|Stab|) holds because centre is characteristic, forcing block form [[P,0],[R,S]] with R free (256 translations); induced pair transforms as S.phi1=phi2(P.,P.). Lemma 4 (derived dim + sorted rank triple of {A,B,A+B} invariant) holds because S in GL(2,F2)=S3 permutes the three nonzero combinations while P preserves rank. Computations: vendor script re-ran clean (GL2=6, GL4=20160, Rad0=3360, rank-type dist (0,4,4):84,(2,4,4):1260,(2,2,4):1680,(4,4,4):336, orbits 84/1260/1680/336 disjoint covering 3360, stabs 1440/96/72/360 with stab*orbit=120960, Aut 368640/24576/18432/92160, 216 Jacobi triples per rep all zero, centre dim 2, derived 1/2/2/2). Independent reimplementation confirmed: Pfaffian rank (Pf=b0b5+b1b4+b2b3) reproduces rank-type dist; alternate congruence P*M*P^T (vs vendor P^T*M*P) reproduces identical orbit sizes, disjointness, coverage, stabilizers and Aut orders; brute-force 6-dim tensors confirm Jacobi, centre 2 and derived dims; bit codes match sparse brackets (e.g. 12=(03),(12); 22=(02),(03),(13)). Invariant vectors (derived,rt) are distinct across four reps, giving search-free non-isomorphism. Proof (lemmas) is distinguished from experimental evidence (4096-fibre and 120960-group enumerations certified by replay script). No boundary error: alternating [x,x]=0 enforced, 2-step implies Jacobi but Jacobi also directly checked (1296 scalar equations), centre exactly 2 checked both via Rad and 6-dim nullspace.

originality.rationale: Live retrieval (Crossref + arXiv, 2026-09-07) finds no source giving a GL(6,F2)-orbit census for (d=6,c=2) over F2 with per-orbit alternating tensors and automorphism orders. Nearest results are materially different: de Graaf 2007 classifies 6-dim nilpotent Lie algebras explicitly over fields of characteristic not 2, excluding F2 where alternating vs skew-symmetric diverge; Abdelwahab-Kaygorodov arXiv:1902.01706 classifies nilpotent binary Lie algebras dim<=6 explicitly in characteristic not 2, same exclusion; Ren-Zhu 2011 classifies 2-step dim8 centre2 (dimension 8 vs 6, complex pencil invariants vs finite 4096-case fibre, no F2 table); Yan-Deng 2013 classifies two-step complex dim8 (characteristic-zero methods, no finite GL-orbit decomposition over F2); Ren-Zhu 2017 classifies 2-step dim9 centre2 (dimension 9 vs 6, same field/method gap); Gauger 1973 gives general metabelian structure via generator-relations without fixed-centre finite-field orbit tables. The F2 fibre (pairs of alternating 4x4 forms, 12 bits, 4096 cases modulo GL(4,F2)xGL(2,F2) with char-2 orbit splitting, GL(4,F2)=A8) is not transportable from complex pencil normal forms, so this is not a parameter substitution. No timestamp, memory or failed search was used to establish priority; all comparisons rest on live-retrieved titles, abstracts and metadata inspected 2026-09-07.

value.rationale: Result is independently worth finding later. It closes a concrete gap left by classical dim6 lists that exclude characteristic 2: first citable per-orbit structure-constant table for the fixed-centre stratum (d=6,c=2) over F2 with centre/derived invariants, rank types, orbit sizes, stabilizers and automorphism orders plus a stdlib replay script (<2 min) and canonical reduction for any input bracket. Motivation (benchmarks for group-Lie, Lazard correspondence and automorphism computations over F2, where every bracket rechecks by O(d^4) evaluation and every orbit claim rechecks by explicit base-change) is genuine and stated. It is not a textbook restatement (textbooks give Heisenberg/complex lists, no F2 (6,2) tensors+Aut), not a mere parameter substitution (char-2 alternating-form splitting requires separate computation), not a tiny unmotivated gain (exact count N=4 with four distinct invariant vectors and full partition, not an epsilon improvement), and not an unexplained enumeration (central-extension reduction to 4096-case fibre + Lemma 1-4 scaffolding + invariant separation explains the table). Limitations are honestly scoped to F2, (6,2), class 2, computer-assisted, with no transfer claimed.

residual_risks: Computer-assisted orbit partition has no hand proof; mitigated by vendor script plus fully independent reimplementation with alternate congruence convention, Pfaffian rank, and orbit-stabilizer cross-checks all agreeing.
Correctness of Aut orders depends on Lemma 3 translation count 2^8; deductively verified and cross-checked via stab*orbit=120960 for all four orbits.
Scope is narrowly limited to F2, (d,c)=(6,2), class 2; no transfer to other characteristics, centre strata or higher class is claimed, and DRAFT states this explicitly.
